description: This file defines the NotesnookModule interface and its implementation for React Native platforms, providing methods for widget and shortcut management, app state, and UI interactions within the Notesnook app.

classes.name: NotesnookModuleInterface
classes.description: Interface defining the methods for interacting with the Notesnook native module, including widget, shortcut, and app state management.

methods.name: getActivityName
methods.description: Returns the activity name as a Promise<string>.

methods.name: setBackgroundColor
methods.description: Sets the background color of the app.

methods.name: setSecureMode
methods.description: Enables or disables secure mode.

methods.name: setAppState
methods.description: Sets the current app state.

methods.name: getAppState
methods.description: Retrieves the current app state.

methods.name: saveAndFinish
methods.description: Saves current data and finishes the activity.

methods.name: setString
methods.description: Stores a string value in a named store.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from a named store.

methods.name: removeString
methods.description: Removes a string value from storage.

methods.name: cancelAndFinish
methods.description: Cancels current operation and finishes.

methods.name: getWidgetId
methods.description: Retrieves the widget ID.

methods.name: getIntent
methods.description: Returns an object with optional intent parameters for opening notes or reminders.

methods.name: getWidgetNotes
methods.description: Retrieves notes associated with the widget.

methods.name: hasWidgetNote
methods.description: Checks if a widget note exists for a given ID.

methods.name: updateWidgetNote
methods.description: Updates a widget note with new data.

methods.name: updateReminderWidget
methods.description: Updates the reminder widget.

methods.name: isGestureNavigationEnabled
methods.description: Checks if gesture navigation is enabled.

methods.name: addShortcut
methods.description: Adds a shortcut with specified parameters.

methods.name: removeShortcut
methods.description: Removes a shortcut by ID.

methods.name: updateShortcut
methods.description: Updates an existing shortcut.

methods.name: removeAllShortcuts
methods.description: Removes all shortcuts.

methods.name: getAllShortcuts
methods.description: Retrieves all shortcuts.
